validation.quality_note: Parse/type validation is not semantic ground truth or measured link precision.

blocking_issues: The proposed mapping is semantically unsafe if it emits both `entity.abn` and `entity.acn` from `AFS_LIC_ABN_ACN`. ASIC documents this as a mixed field: show ABN if supplied; otherwise show ACN; otherwise null. No per-row type discriminator is present. Checksum validation alone is not a documented mutually exclusive mapping condition, and the displayed declarative mapping has no such exclusive condition. The field must remain unmapped or be routed through a demonstrably type-exclusive discriminator before human approval.
warnings: Row grain is correctly understood as one current, point-in-time AFS licence-register entry for a licence holder, rather than a condition, prior licence, branch, service location, legal entity, or reporting group. `AFS_LIC_NUM` is a licence identifier and cannot be promoted to an entity identifier; retaining it only in provenance is an acceptable ontology limitation.

It is correct not to map `AFS_LIC_NAME` to legal or trading name. The help file calls it a register-entry name and expressly permits individual or organisation names. This source provides no basis for legal-name, trading-name, entity-type, or historical-name assertions.
It is correct not to map the AFS start date to entity registration/incorporation date. It is licence/licensee timing, not entity registration timing.
No legal-entity status is asserted, correctly. Current inclusion in this AFS-licensee snapshot does not establish active company status, deregistration, liquidation, or suspension.

Mapped locality, state, postcode, and country are supported as components of the current principal business address. `address_role: business` is reasonable only if consumers do not reinterpret it as registered office, branch, or service location. No street/full address is available. Blank values can reflect failure to validate an address, as disclosed.

Country is source text. ASIC represents addresses outside Australia as `International`, so it must not be standardized into a particular country or the ontology default AU. Mapping raw country text is partial and should retain this limitation.

The source has no row-level observed/change/snapshot timestamp. CKAN last-modified may be used only as the clearly labelled publication proxy shown, not as when the individual record or address was stated/changed. UTC for a timezone-naive proxy is an implementation assumption, not source evidence.

The uncalibrated source-reliability and field-confidence scores are disclosed appropriately and should not be read as measured correctness. Address confidence is broadly plausible, but it does not repair the mixed-identifier issue.

Leaving conditions and pre-FSR values unmapped is appropriate: they are serialized licence-related values, may be multi-valued, and the supplied ontology has no matching licence/permission/history fields.
evidence_checked: ASIC Help File p.3: the dataset is a point-in-time snapshot of public information for current AFS licensees.

ASIC Help File p.8: AFS licence number is a unique licence/licensee identifier; register-entry name may be an individual or organisation; the mixed ABN/ACN field supplies ABN if available, otherwise ACN.
ASIC Help File pp.9-10: fields are components of the current principal business address; blank address fields can mean unvalidated input; foreign addresses are represented as International.
ASIC Help File p.11: conditions are current licence authorisations in two serialized formats.

Discovery evidence: reviewed rows exhibit nonempty unique licence numbers in the sampled 300 records, 11-digit mixed identifiers in examples, address components, and serialized tilde-delimited conditions/prior licences.
Proposed mapping/validation: it deliberately leaves name, licence start date, conditions, prior licences, and register name unmapped; it labels the resource timestamp as a publication proxy.
